title.en: What Can Outlast Us? · Eight Languages

summary.en: Five complete essays now add independent German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Korean rewrites. Archives, workshops, reading time and later generations retain their full arguments and examples. Cross-review preserves the difference between continuity and correctness, and the limits of ratios, simulations and forecasts. Existing Chinese and English prose is unchanged.
summary.zh: 五篇新增德法西日韩完整独立重写。保留资料室、作坊、阅读时间与后来者的全部论证和例子，逐段交叉核对延续与正当性的区别，以及比例、模拟和预测的限度；原有中英繁正文不变。
summary.zh-hant: 五篇新增德法西日韓完整獨立重寫。保留資料室、作坊、閱讀時間與後來者的全部論證和例子，逐段交叉核對延續與正當性的區別，以及比例、模擬和預測的限度；原有中英繁正文不變。
